title: Entity measurement display
responsibility: Formats one unit’s recorded size and declared performance measurements without combining profiles.

inputs.name: byteSize.count
inputs.description: Byte count to format; sign is retained.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.unit
inputs.description: Unit supplying identity, emitted targets and performance budgets.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.record
inputs.description: Host-selected verification record, or null when none is available.

outputs.name: tolerancePolicy
outputs.description: Maximum accepted declared timing tolerance of 0.05, used to flag looser budgets.

outputs.name: byteSize
outputs.description: Decimal B, KB or MB size, rounded to at most one decimal place using 1,000-based units.

outputs.name: entityMeasure
outputs.description: Source, emitted-size and complexity rows plus separate workload/profile observations. Selected-commit source observations take precedence over missing or older record placeholders. Emitted rows retain target identity; none is inapplicable. Focused benchmarks remain distinct from full verification.
